The [[Eternal Forgemaster]] crafts [[prestige armor]] for all [[profession]]s. All armor is crafted with an empty [[insignia slot]]. In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to appear in [[the Fissure of Woe]] players must finish the following quest:
*[[The Eternal Forgemaster]]
In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to craft armor for players, the following quests must be completed as well:
*[[Defend the Temple of War]]
*[[Restore the Temple of War]]

==Locations==
*[[Fissure of Woe]]
**{{NPC location|Temple of War}}
